## Phase 1 Validation Report — PASS

### E2E Test Results: 7/7 passed (4.3s)

| # | Test | Result |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | GET /api/health returns 200 status | ✅ PASS |
| 2 | GET /api/health returns correct JSON shape | ✅ PASS |
| 3 | GET /api/health returns Content-Type application/json | ✅ PASS |
| 4 | Frontend renders the agentrack header | ✅ PASS |
| 5 | Page has correct title "agentrack" | ✅ PASS |
| 6 | Page body renders without JS errors | ✅ PASS |
| 7 | Vite proxy forwards /api/health to backend | ✅ PASS |

### Spec Compliance Checklist

| Criterion | Status | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Project structure matches spec 4.1 | ✅ | All expected directories/files present. Missing route files (issues, comments, etc.) are expected for Phase 1 scope. |
| Backend uses Hono + Bun | ✅ | `hono: "^4.7.0"`, `bun run --watch` |
| CORS middleware | ✅ | `app.use("/api/*", cors())` |
| Logger middleware | ✅ | `app.use("/api/*", logger())` |
| React 19 | ✅ | `"react": "^19.1.0"` |
| Vite 6.x | ✅ | `"vite": "^6.3.0"` |
| TypeScript | ✅ | `"typescript": "~5.7.0"`, tsc --noEmit passes clean |
| Tailwind CSS 4.x | ✅ | `"tailwindcss": "^4.1.0"` with @tailwindcss/vite plugin |
| shadcn/ui | ✅ | v4.8.2, base-nova style, components.json configured |
| Tracker singleton (utils/tracker.ts) | ✅ | Uses AGENTACK_CWD env var with fallback to process.cwd() |
| Error handler maps error codes | ✅ | NOT_FOUND→404, NOT_INITIALIZED→500, TOKEN_REQUIRED→403, INVALID_TOKEN→401, VALIDATION_ERROR→400, default→500 |
| package.json scripts | ✅ | dev:server, dev:frontend, dev, build — all present and correct |
| Frontend build | ✅ | `bun run build` succeeds, produces dist/ output |
| Health endpoint response shape | ✅ | `{"status":"ok","tracker":"initialized"|"not_initialized"}` |

### Spec Deviations

**None found.** The Phase 1 implementation is fully spec-compliant.

### Observations (non-blocking)

1. No lint configuration exists (no ESLint or Biome). Consider adding for code quality enforcement in later phases.
2. The `AGENTACK_AUTHOR` env var (spec 4.5) is not implemented yet — acceptable since no mutation endpoints exist in Phase 1.
3. TypeScript strict mode is enabled with `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters` — good practice.

### Test Artifacts

- E2E tests created: `packages/webapp/e2e/phase1-validation.spec.ts` (7 tests)
- Playwright config: `packages/webapp/playwright.config.ts`
- @playwright/test added as dev dependency

Done. Phase 1 validation complete — all 7 E2E tests pass, no spec deviations found. Full report in previous comment. Test infrastructure (Playwright config + E2E test suite) now in place for future phases.
